{{Quote|The capitol has been very active recently with the news of the new election.|[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tour Aryon]]|<ref name="AED" />}}
The '''Bestine Capitol Building''', also referred to as the '''Tatooine Capitol building''' or as the '''Imperial Capitol''', was the building situated in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] that was home to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] leaders of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] government. The capitol building was in operation by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], and contained offices for a number of Tatooine's most important [[Politics/Legends|political]] officials, including [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tour Aryon]], [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]], [[Officer of Defense]] [[Victor Visalis]], and [[Director of Commerce]] [[Sean Trenwell]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bestine Capitol Building was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
